title: The Shack
author: William Paul Young
summary: Mackenzie Phillips is shattered after his youngest daughter is abducted and killed. A mysterious note draws him back to the shack where she died, and there he meets God in three human forms and confronts his pain.
readIf: you want a faith-centered story about grief, forgiveness and difficult questions about suffering.
skipIf: you prefer secular fiction or are uncomfortable with a story that starts with a child's murder.
